title: Seeding's untimed work gets its own timers
body:
Seeding's `[misc.]` was 19 s on all Pfam against one MGnify shard. Writing the mmseqs query and target dbs in `mmseqs.rs` had no timer. Neither had the slicing, deciding and merging of progressive seeding in `seed_stage.rs`.

## Proposal

- Add `DbWrite`, and for progressive seeding `Slice`, `Decide` and `Merge`, so `[misc.]` shrinks to noise.
- Rename the enum `MmseqsTimed` to `SeedTimed`, since half its variants no longer time an mmseqs call, and drop "(mmseqs)" from the branch label.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text: Committed on runtime-tree. Timers verified by reading the diff only: every new timer is on an mmseqs code path and mmseqs is not installed on this machine. First real prog-mode run should check that seeding's [misc.] is now small.
